name: OKC_BUS_DOC_TYPES_B
description: Stores all business document types and preferences related to those documents. This information is seeded by each product team that integrates with Oracle Contracts to implement Contract authoring.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Unique Code that identifies business document type

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_CLASS
columns.description: Document Class to which the document type belongs. Refers to the LOOKUP_CODE in FND_LOOKUPS where LOOKUP_TYPE  = OKC_DOCUMENT_CLASS

columns.name: PROVISION_ALLOWED_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether provisions are allowed for this document type or not. Possible values are Y and N

columns.name: DOC_PREVIEW_FUNCTION
columns.description: The FND Form function that points to the page used to launch Contract Preview.

columns.name: INTENT
columns.description: Intent of the document type. Possible values are Buy and Sell

columns.name: DOC_VIEW_DETAILS_FUNCTION
columns.description: FND Form function used for viewing document details from Manage Deliverables page. This is only used in Procurement Contracts

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_HEADER_FUNCTION
columns.description: FND Form Function to be used to display notification header region in deliverable notification.This region will include document specific attributes to provide a context to the notification. This is only used in Procurement Contracts

columns.name: CONTRACT_TERMS_FUNCTION
columns.description: FND Form Function for contract terms structure page. This function will be used in the terms authoring sub flows to navigate back to structure page

columns.name: SHOW_EXT_VAR_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether supplier updateable flag is to be shown on the UI or not. Possible values are Y and N. This is only used in Procurement Contracts

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of the application/product to which the document type belongs.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: ENABLE_AMEND_SUMMARY_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether to display View amendment summary action on the Contract Terms page or not. Possible values are Y and N. This is only used in Procurement Contracts

columns.name: ENABLE_DELIVERABLES_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether deliverables functionality should be enabled for the document type or not. Possible values are Y and N. This is only used in Procurement Contracts

columns.name: DOC_VERSION_VIEW
columns.description: Database View name for the document versions. This view will be used to render the version poplist in Manage Contract Documents page

columns.name: ENABLE_ATTACHMENTS_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether to enable Contract Documents functionality or not. Possible values are Y and N

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_USERLIST_PROC
columns.description: Name of the routine for retrieving external user list on the document to send notifications while managing deliverables. This is only used in Procurement Contracts

columns.name: SHOW_IN_LOV_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether to show the business document type in business document type LOVs while defining allowable Template Usage. Possible values are Y and N.

columns.name: SHOW_IN_WORKBENCH_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this document type should be displayed on the Deliverable Workbench or not. Possible values are Y and N. This is only used in Procurement Contracts

columns.name: SHOW_PREVIEW_BTN_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether to display Preview Contract action on the contract terms  page or not. Possible values are Y and N

columns.name: TARGET_RESPONSE_DOC_TYPE
columns.description: Stores target document type for a given document. For example, Bid is a response document for Auction. This information is used to drive logic in the Copy during response process in Sourcing.

columns.name: DISABLE_AMEND_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether to enable amendments feature for the business document or not. Possible values are Y and N

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Document Type effective date.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Document Type end date.

columns.name: SHOW_AUTH_PARTY_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the Authoring Party field is relevant to this business document. Default value is `Y`. If set to `N`, the field will be not be displayed in the UI and the value for Authoring Party will be defaulted to `Internal`.

columns.name: ENABLE_ATTACHED_DOC_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if Attached Document based contract terms authoring is allowed for this business document. Default value is Y. If set to N, the Contract Source can not be changed to Attached Document for this business document type.

columns.name: VARIABLE_RESOLUTION_AM
columns.description: Application Module Definition.  This will be used to instantiate and resolve the system variables

columns.name: MULTIPARTIES_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether the Business Document Type Supports Multiparties.

columns.name: VARIABLE_RESOLUTION_HEADER_VO
columns.description: Header VO.  This will be used to resolve the system variable values

columns.name: VARIABLE_RESOLUTION_LINES_VO
columns.description: Line VO.  This will be used to resolve the line system variable values

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
